title: Precognitive dream of the Focus magazine

tellings.quote: And there in the middle of the living room floor, just as I had dreamt, was a magazine. I picked it up. It was called Focus.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, says that in 1972, while living in married student housing in Berkeley, California, he dreamed of a magazine lying on his living room floor. He says that afterwards he found a magazine there in the middle of the floor, just as he had dreamt, called Focus, put out by KQED, a local public broadcaster. If true, it would be a dream that showed the future.
